theme: 3 terms for space in SwiftUI layout: the pusher, the margin and the line-up rule

terms.definition: A flexible view that pushes other views apart by taking all the free space.
terms.example: Add a Spacer to push the Edit button to the right.

terms.definition: The extra space that you add around a view.
terms.example: Add some Padding, so the text does not touch the edge.

terms.definition: The rule that decides how views line up inside a stack.
terms.example: Change the Alignment to leading, so the text starts on the left.

video.title: Spacer, Padding & Alignment | Day 133
video.description:
Learn to explain how to control space in a SwiftUI layout: Spacer, Padding & Alignment, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Spacer - A flexible view that pushes other views apart by taking all the free space.
Padding - The extra space that you add around a view.
Alignment - The rule that decides how views line up inside a stack.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Spacer, Padding & Alignment in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
스페이서, 패딩, 얼라인먼트 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Spacer - A flexible view that pushes other views apart by taking all the free space.
한국어: 스페이서: 남는 공간을 모두 차지해서 다른 뷰를 밀어내는 유연한 뷰

Padding - The extra space that you add around a view.
한국어: 패딩: 뷰 주위에 더하는 여분의 공간

Alignment - The rule that decides how views line up inside a stack.
한국어: 얼라인먼트: 스택 안에서 뷰를 어떻게 정렬할지 정하는 규칙

landscape.hook: Can you explain Spacer, Padding and Alignment in English?

dialogue.title: Fix the profile row

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the Edit button sticks to the name. I want it on the far right.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a Spacer between them, like in the code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It takes all the free space, so it pushes the Edit button to the edge.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now the card touches the screen edges.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add Padding. It puts space around the card.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I use Padding on one side only?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The code limits the Padding to `.horizontal`, so only the left and right sides get space.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The subtitle is in the middle, but I want it on the left.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Set the Alignment of the VStack to `.leading`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does that Alignment also move the HStack?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. Alignment only controls how views line up inside that one stack.
